# linear_webhooks (Data Source)

List webhook subscriptions with cursor pagination. Filters match exactly and combine with AND. Signing secrets are never queried or returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "linear_webhooks" "enabled" {
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `all_public_teams` (Boolean) Filter by all-public-team subscription status.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Filter by delivery status.
- `label` (String) Exact label filter.
- `team_id` (String) Subscribed team UUID filter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Collection identifier.
- `webhooks` (Attributes List) Matching subscriptions, sorted by UUID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks))

<a id="nestedatt--webhooks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhooks`

Read-Only:

- `all_public_teams` (Boolean) Whether all public teams are subscribed.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether event delivery is enabled.
- `id` (String) Webhook UUID.
- `label` (String) Subscription label.
- `resource_types` (Set of String) Subscribed event resource names.
- `team_id` (String) Subscribed team UUID, when team-scoped.
- `url` (String) Receiver URL. Null for OAuth application webhooks.
